ledger: 00:00–00:00.50: Two red, three green and three yellow balls are visible in the glass bowl; both hands reach into the bowl. Anatomical right hand is on screen-left.
00:00.75–00:02.25: A red ball is raised above the bowl and held between both hands; two other red balls remain visible below. Its exact source is obscured during the initial reach.
00:02.25–00:02.75: The raised red ball is lowered into the bowl by the right hand and becomes obscured among the other balls; no transfer to the table or another container is visible.

00:00–00:05.00: Initially front-left red ball remains in the bowl, with intermittent right-finger contact and occlusion. From 00:05.00 onward it joins the stirred contents; individual red-ball identity becomes unresolved.

00:00–00:05.00: Initially central red ball remains in the bowl beneath or beside the right fingertips. From 00:05.00 onward it joins the stirred contents; individual red-ball identity becomes unresolved.
00:00–00:05.00: Initially rear-left green ball remains in the bowl, intermittently hidden by the right hand. From 00:05.00 onward it rolls among the stirred contents.
00:00–00:05.00: Initially right-middle green ball remains in the bowl beside the right-side yellow ball. From 00:05.00 onward it rolls among the stirred contents.
00:00–00:05.00: Initially front-right green ball remains against the bowl's front interior. From 00:05.00 onward it rolls among the stirred contents.
00:00–00:05.00: Initially rear yellow ball remains inside the bowl. From 00:05.00 onward it rolls among the stirred contents.
00:00–00:05.00: Initially right-side yellow ball remains inside the bowl; the right hand sweeps across its position around 00:05.25, starting its movement with the other balls.
00:00–00:05.00: Initially front-left yellow ball remains against the bowl's front interior, beside the right fingers. From 00:05.00 onward it rolls among the stirred contents.

00:05.25–00:09.75: Right hand continuously stirs the balls inside the bowl while left hand holds the rim. Same-colored balls cannot be individually distinguished through crossings, finger occlusion and motion blur; no ball is visibly retrieved from outside or transferred out.
00:07.75–00:09.75: At least four separate red balls are visible within the stirred contents, exceeding the three visible during the earlier two-handed red-ball inspection.
00:00–00:09.75: Glass bowl remains on the wooden table; left hand steadies its rim during stirring. The nearby small metal vessel and its contents are not manipulated.
Audio is unassessed; custody observations use timestamped visual frames only.

findings.entity: Red balls inside the glass bowl
findings.description: At 00:01.00–00:02.00, one red ball is held above the bowl and two red balls remain inside. After the held ball is returned, the hands only stir the contents. At 00:07.75, at least four distinct red balls are simultaneously visible: one at the back beneath the left fingers, one centrally, one on the right and one beneath the stirring fingers on the left. The excess red-ball population persists in the closing frames without any visible addition or retrieval from outside the bowl.
